test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Q started from a point and walked towards the south for 42 m, then from there he turned right and walked 2 m, then he turned right again and walked 30 m, and then turned left and walked 10 m. In which direction is Q facing now?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Drawing the diagram according to the given information,

 
• Q started from a point and walked towards the south for 42 m.
 
• Then he turned right and walked 2 m.
 
• Then he turned right again and walked 30 m.
 
• Then turned left and walked 10 m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c899cb3b355081a992ae56f081ef48bdc2fef4b2da1bdd8b30d1e4e9fed7d943.png] 

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b634e1247a4b7fbfa217f7796d29d5010d227a3f95a1db0965ce37a22572a3a.png] 

**​**Here, Q is facing in the 'West' direction.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
